name: RT-AX88U
notes: This support-only entry covers RT-AX88U (RT-AX88U). It summarizes the ASUS stock firmware and AsusWrt-Merlin support listed for this model. No firmware was flashed.

officialSupport.summary: ended according to ASUS; a later firmware build is listed

hardware.note: Wi-Fi: AX6000: 2.4 GHz 4x4 up to 1148 Mbps, 5 GHz 4x4 up to 4804 Mbps; Ports: 1 WAN, 8 LAN, 2 USB 3.1 Gen 1; SoC is not named in the product specification.

supportRoutes.name: AsusWrt-Merlin
supportRoutes.description: AsusWrt-Merlin 3004.388.12_2 (2026-08-20) is listed for this model. Check the supported-device list for the model and any hardware-revision distinctions.
requirements: Confirm the exact model and any hardware revision against the linked supported-device list; similar model names can use different firmware.

supportRoutes.name: ASUS stock firmware
supportRoutes.description: ASUS lists 3.0.0.4.388_24386 dated 2026-10-22 for RT-AX88U on its model support page.
requirements: Match RT-AX88U exactly and check the model support page before downloading.
ASUS demonstrates Firmware Restoration separately as its rescue-mode route.

supportRoutes.name: Firmware Restoration
supportRoutes.description: ASUS documents Firmware Restoration for rescue mode. Its FAQ demonstrates the procedure on an RT-AC68U, so its LED timing is not confirmed for this model.
requirements: Unzip the stock firmware before using the utility; it cannot upload an archive.
Use a wired PC with the documented static IP, enter rescue mode by holding Reset while powering on, then restore the stock image.
